reason: This plugin is primarily a search utility extension that replaces the DeepSeek Harness web_search provider with a multi-backend implementation, using Exa and Firecrawl, and adds fallback behavior when one backend fails.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于 DeepSeek Harness 的 web_search 功能，提供 Exa 与 Firecrawl 两种后端的搜索能力，并支持自动切换与可选免密钥方式。
summaries.en: This plugin extends DeepSeek Harness web_search with Exa and Firecrawl backends, adding automatic failover and optional keyless search operation.

capabilities: Send web search requests to external provider APIs (Exa and Firecrawl) and return source/snippet results
Automatically fail over across multiple backends on provider errors, including rate-limit conditions
Apply per-backend cooldown after rate-limit responses and support keyless fallback mode

reasons.code: README describes this plugin as a replacement web_search provider for DeepSeek Harness with Exa and Firecrawl backends and automatic failover on errors.

Configuration documentation shows provider selection, preferred backend ordering, API/key options, and rate-limit cooldown behavior as runtime behavior, confirming external network integration with user-facing control.
Repository manifests the package as a DSH plugin with a bundle patch and declares peer dependencies on dsh-web and related runtime modules, indicating integration into the host web tool seam.
